spec_evidence.checked: Cached vercel OAS snapshots: dheCipherSuite present in web-analytics query response schemas (10 occurrences) from v1.28.5 through v1.28.8, zero occurrences in v1.28.9 and v1.28.10. No replacement field with cipher-suite semantics appears anywhere in the newer specs.

fix.migration_guide: The dheCipherSuite dimension was dropped from all web-analytics query responses with no successor field. The upstream simply stopped reporting this TLS telemetry dimension. Consumers that read or group by dheCipherSuite must delete the field access; the read now yields undefined and any aggregation keyed on it collapses into a single undefined bucket. The safe mechanical migration is to remove the field from response destructuring, group-by keys, and any downstream display logic. There is no way to recover the data from another endpoint.
